rows.grounds: locative qualifier of the accompanying crescent moon; compound vāma-pārśva-sthita
connects this feature to the preceding description

items.question: With what lunar feature is the left-side-situated element conjoined?
premises: An element is described as joined or conjoined.
The accompanying feature is the crescent moon.
That crescent moon is situated on the left side.
items.inference: The described element is conjoined with a crescent moon situated on the left side.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the joined element depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: And it is joined with the crescent moon situated on the left side.
